You are red-teaming a filter. Do NOT modify any file under /opt/SDPO. Work only in a new directory /tmp/redteam (create it).

Context: an RL setup (SDPO) trains a coding model on terminal tasks. Each task has a prompt + public files (visible to the model), and a private directory with the task's hidden tests (test code, fixtures, golden files, check scripts, any language/runner). After the model ("student") leaves a workspace, the hidden tests run on it and the raw runner output is turned into "environment feedback" for a self-teacher model. The teacher must only learn what the student could have known: which checks failed (by name) and how, and what the student's own code printed/raised/returned/failed to compile on. It must learn NOTHING that comes from the test side: test inputs, fixture values, expected values (static or computed by the tests at runtime), golden-file lines, values baked into parametrized test ids or subtest names, anything the tests print -- and that holds even when the student's output repeats/echoes such a value (e.g. the student's exception message containing the hidden input it was given). Values given by the prompt/public files are fine (the student saw them).

The filter: /opt/SDPO/verl/utils/reward_score/feedback/terminal_feedback.py, entry point
  build_feedback(output: str, exit_code: int, *, pool, task_id, workspace) -> str
where pool is a directory with pool/tasks/<task_id>/prompt.md (+ optional pool/tasks/<task_id>/public/...) and pool/private/<task_id>/... (the hidden test side), and workspace is the student's workspace directory. It replaces hidden things with "<hidden>". Read the module to understand it, then attack it. Load it by path so you don't need the rest of the repo:
  import importlib.util, sys
  spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tfb", "/opt/SDPO/verl/utils/reward_score/feedback/terminal_feedback.py")
  tfb = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules["tfb"] = tfb; spec.loader.exec_module(tfb)
Run python with `python3 -I`. Real examples of tasks and runner outputs: /data/sdpo_terminal/pool (tasks + private tests) and /data/sdpo_terminal/runs/2026-10-05_sdpo-q3-1.7b/attempts/<id>/{meta.json,runner.log,workspace/} (read-only; copy anything you want to modify). go, cargo, node, bats, gcc, pytest are installed and work offline if you want genuine runner output.

Goal: find concrete cases where a test-side value survives into build_feedback's output, in realistic setups a task author could plausibly write (any language, test runner, or custom check script) and realistic student code (a small model writing ordinary code; it is not trying to smuggle secrets). Think about: how values get printed by different runners and check scripts, formatting/transformations of values (case, separators, number formats, truncation, wrapping, escaping, encodings), values the tests compute or generate at runtime, values the student's code echoes, values that coincide with words the filter treats as generic or as names, test names/ids, numbers the filter treats as line numbers or counts, and anything else you can think of. Ignore leaks of tiny values that coincide with line numbers/test counts, and values that also appear in the prompt -- those are known and accepted. Also report (separately, briefly) any case where the filter crashes, is very slow (>1s on a normal-size output), or is nondeterministic.

Deliverable (your final message): a list of concrete leaking cases, most realistic and severe first. For each: a minimal reproduction (the private file(s), workspace file(s), the runner output string, the exact leaked value as it appears in the feedback), why it leaks (which rule in the module lets it through), and how realistic it is. Put each reproduction as a standalone runnable script under /tmp/redteam/case_<n>.py that prints the feedback and asserts the leak, and list the script paths. If after a serious effort you find nothing realistic, say so plainly and list what you tried. Keep the report under 1500 words.

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

265	              follow_links=False):
266	    """[(relative path, text)] of the files under root. The student's tree: no symlinks (a link to the tests is not
267	    the student's text). The test side: links followed, as the copy the tests run from has their content."""
268	    out = []

270	        return out

272	    seen = set()

275	        if real in seen:

277	            continue

286	                continue
287	            text = _read_text(p, max_file)
288	            if text is None:
289	                continue

407	def _strip_heredocs(text: str, out: Lexed) -> str:
408	    """heredoc bodies (shell, ruby, perl, php) are data: move them to the literals"""
409	    if "<<" not in text:
410	        return text
411	    lines = text.split("\n")
412	    kept, i = [], 0
413	    while i < len(lines):
414	        line = lines[i]
415	        kept.append(line)
416	        m = _HEREDOC.search(line)
417	        i += 1
418	        if not m:
419	            continue
420	        end, body = m.group(2), []
421	        while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip() != end:
422	            body.append(lines[i])
423	            i += 1
424	        out.literals.append("\n".join(body))
425	        out.messages.append(False)
426	        kept.append("")
427	        i += 1
428	    return "\n".join(kept)

721	def _eval_const(node, consts, depth=0):
722	    """value of a constant expression (literals, known names, arithmetic, a few str methods), else None"""
723	    if depth > 30:
724	        return None
725	    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, (int, float, str)) and not isinstance(node.value, bool):
726	        return node.value
727	    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
728	        return consts.get(node.id)
729	    if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.USub, ast.UAdd)):
730	        v = _eval_const(node.operand, consts, depth + 1)
731	        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
732	            return -v if isinstance(node.op, ast.USub) else v
733	        return None
734	    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
735	        a = _eval_const(node.left, consts, depth + 1)
736	        b = _eval_const(node.right, consts, depth + 1)
737	        if a is None or b is None:
738	            return None
739	        try:
740	            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
741	                if isinstance(a, str) != isinstance(b, str):
742	                    return None
743	                r = a + b
744	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
745	                r = a - b
746	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
747	                if isinstance(a, str) or isinstance(b, str):
748	                    return None
749	                r = a * b
750	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.FloorDiv):
751	                r = a // b
752	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
753	                r = a / b
754	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mod):
755	                if isinstance(a, str):
756	                    return None
757	                r = a % b
758	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Pow):
759	                if not isinstance(b, int) or not 0 <= b <= 64 or abs(a) > 10**6:
760	                    return None
761	                r = a**b
762	            else:
763	                return None
764	        except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, OverflowError):
765	            return None
766	        if isinstance(r, str) and len(r) > 1000 or isinstance(r, int) and abs(r) > _MAX_INT:
767	            return None
768	        return r
769	    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and not node.args and not node.keywords:
770	        v = _eval_const(node.func.value, consts, depth + 1)
771	        if isinstance(v, str) and node.func.attr in ("upper", "lower", "strip", "title", "capitalize", "casefold"):
772	            return getattr(v, node.func.attr)()
773	    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and len(node.args) == 1 and not node.keywords:
774	        v = _eval_const(node.args[0], consts, depth + 1)
775	        if node.func.id == "str" and v is not None:
776	            return str(v)
777	        if node.func.id in ("int", "abs", "len") and v is not None:
778	            try:
779	                return {"int": int, "abs": abs, "len": len}[node.func.id](v)
780	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
781	                return None
782	    if isinstance(node, ast.JoinedStr):
783	        parts = _fstring_parts(node, consts)
784	        if parts is not None and not any(is_hole(x) for x in parts):
785	            return "".join(parts)
786	    return None

803	    """template of an f-string: constants and values folded from the student's constants as text, HOLE / SHOLE for
804	    the rest (SHOLE: the expression only uses module-level constants, imports and builtins of the student's code)"""

822	        else:

896	def _student_python(text: str, consts: dict, folded: list, templates: list):
897	    try:
898	        tree = ast.parse(text)
899	    except (SyntaxError, ValueError, RecursionError, MemoryError):

900	        return False
901	    assigns, strings, fstrings, exprs = [], [], [], []
902	    in_fstring = set()
903	    for node in ast.walk(tree):  # one walk; the passes below go over these lists
904	        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
905	            assigns.append(([t.id for t in node.targets if isinstance(t, ast.Name)], node.value))
906	        elif isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name) and node.value is not None:
907	            assigns.append(([node.target.id], node.value))
908	        elif isinstance(node, ast.JoinedStr):
909	            fstrings.append(node)
910	            for v in node.values:
911	                in_fstring.add(id(v))
912	                if isinstance(v, ast.FormattedValue) and v.format_spec is not None:
913	                    in_fstring.add(id(v.format_spec))
914	        elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
915	            strings.append(node)
916	        elif isinstance(node, (ast.BinOp, ast.UnaryOp, ast.Call)):
917	            exprs.append(node)

919	    # other such names, imports, builtins
920	    static_names = set(_BUILTIN_NAMES)
921	    module_assigns = []
922	    for node in tree.body:
923	        if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):

930	            if used <= static_names:

932	    for _ in range(3):  # resolve constants defined in terms of other constants
933	        for targets, value in assigns:

935	                v = _eval_const(value, consts)
936	                if v is not None:
937	                    for t in targets:
938	                        consts.setdefault(t, v)
939	    for node in exprs:
940	        v = _eval_const(node, consts)
941	        if v is not None:
942	            folded.append(v)
943	    for node in fstrings:
944	        if id(node) not in in_fstring:
945	            parts = _fstring_parts(node, consts, static_names)
946	            if parts is not None:
947	                templates.append(parts)
948	    for node in strings:
949	        if id(node) not in in_fstring:
950	            templates.append(_split_placeholders(node.value, consts))
951	    return True

721	def _eval_const(node, consts, depth=0):
722	    """value of a constant expression (literals, known names, arithmetic, a few str methods), else None"""
723	    if depth > 30:
724	        return None
725	    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, (int, float, str)) and not isinstance(node.value, bool):
726	        return node.value
727	    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
728	        return consts.get(node.id)
729	    if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.USub, ast.UAdd)):
730	        v = _eval_const(node.operand, consts, depth + 1)
731	        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
732	            return -v if isinstance(node.op, ast.USub) else v
733	        return None
734	    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
735	        a = _eval_const(node.left, consts, depth + 1)
736	        b = _eval_const(node.right, consts, depth + 1)
737	        if a is None or b is None:
738	            return None
739	        try:
740	            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
741	                if isinstance(a, str) != isinstance(b, str):
742	                    return None
743	                r = a + b
744	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
745	                r = a - b
746	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
747	                if isinstance(a, str) or isinstance(b, str):
748	                    return None
749	                r = a * b
750	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.FloorDiv):
751	                r = a // b
752	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
753	                r = a / b
754	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mod):
755	                if isinstance(a, str):
756	                    return None
757	                r = a % b
758	            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Pow):
759	                if not isinstance(b, int) or not 0 <= b <= 64 or abs(a) > 10**6:
760	                    return None
761	                r = a**b
762	            else:
763	                return None
764	        except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, OverflowError):
765	            return None
766	        if isinstance(r, str) and len(r) > 1000 or isinstance(r, int) and abs(r) > _MAX_INT:
767	            return None
768	        return r
769	    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and not node.args and not node.keywords:
770	        v = _eval_const(node.func.value, consts, depth + 1)
771	        if isinstance(v, str) and node.func.attr in ("upper", "lower", "strip", "title", "capitalize", "casefold"):
772	            return getattr(v, node.func.attr)()
773	    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and len(node.args) == 1 and not node.keywords:
774	        v = _eval_const(node.args[0], consts, depth + 1)

777	        if node.func.id in ("int", "abs", "len") and v is not None:
778	            try:

780	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
